sections.text:
[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 3XL.
Performs a critical hit.
Increases the target's Break by XL. Increases Ability Power up to a max of 4XL if target is already in Break.
Ability Power scales with the number of Book type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of 4XL+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate scales with the number of Book type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of L (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).
